effects: The signer sends `_underlying` USDe to the vault, using the signer's USDe allowance to the vault.
The vault deposits that USDe into sUSDe and mints stk-USDe shares to `receiver`.

Before the deposit, `_harvest` mints management and performance fee shares to the fee recipient. This dilutes existing holders.

findings.title: withdraw shows 'Withdraw exactly X USDe', but the receiver gets sUSDe
findings.evidence: AllocatorVaultV3.withdraw: `uint256 assets = strategy.previewWithdraw(_underlying); ... if (config.hasCooldown) { IERC20(address(strategy)).safeTransfer(receiver, assets); }`. The descriptor field reads `"label": "Withdraw exactly"` with `"token": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingToken"` (USDe). Case 1 (redeem, same branch) shows the vault sending sUSDe, so hasCooldown is on.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw sUSDe worth USDe amount". Change the label to 'USDe value to withdraw (paid in sUSDe)'. You can also add a constant field 'Receive asset: sUSDe'.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many stk-USDe shares the vault burns from the owner
findings.evidence: AllocatorVaultV3.withdraw: `uint256 shares = _convertToShares(assets, true); ... _burn(owner, shares);`. No max-shares parameter exists.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns `shares` stk-USDe from `owner`. If the signer is not the owner, it spends the owner's allowance to the signer.
With `config.hasCooldown` set, the vault sends sUSDe (the strategy shares) to `receiver`, not USDe.
The amount received comes from the vault exchange rate after `_harvest` mints fee shares. It has no minimum.

findings.title: redeem does not show that the signer receives sUSDe; the reader expected USDe
findings.evidence: AllocatorVaultV3.redeem: `if (config.hasCooldown) { IERC20(address(strategy)).safeTransfer(receiver, assets); }`. Case 1: the signer receives 1626.3125 sUSDe (0x9d39…3497). The screen shows only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. The reader believed 'Underlying asset (likely USDe)'.

findings.title: withdraw shows 'Withdraw exactly X USDe', but the receiver gets sUSDe
findings.reason: The screen says the receiver gets exactly X USDe. With hasCooldown on, which the mined redeem shows, the receiver instead gets previewWithdraw(X) sUSDe, a different asset and a different number, and no USDe at all. The storage-value exception in the severity guide applies: the stored flag changes what the signer receives against the amount shown, so this is critical.
findings.quote: AllocatorVaultV3.withdraw: `uint256 assets = strategy.previewWithdraw(_underlying); ... if (config.hasCooldown) { IERC20(address(strategy)).safeTransfer(receiver, assets); }`. descriptor.json withdraw field: `"path": "_underlying", "label": "Withdraw exactly", "format": "tokenAmount", "params": {"token": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingToken"}` (USDe 0x4c9E…8B3). Mined case 1 (redeem, same `config.hasCooldown` branch): 1626.31 sUSDe (0x9d39…3497) sent from the vault to the signer.

findings.format: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
findings.title: redeem does not show that the signer receives sUSDe; the reader expected USDe
findings.reason: Nothing on the screen is wrong. It shows the shares leaving and the signer as recipient, and it never claims USDe; that guess came from the reader. Which token arrives and how much is decided by storage (hasCooldown) and the share price, and no shown amount is reduced. Under not-critical item 3 (a value read from storage or derived by the contract) and item 12 (receiving the vault's asset is what redeeming means), this is info, or a warning if a label stating the output token were added.
findings.quote: descriptor.json redeem shows only `shares` 'Shares to redeem' (tokenAmount, tokenPath @.to), `receiver` 'To', `owner` 'Owner'. Nothing on screen names USDe or any output asset. AllocatorVaultV3.redeem picks the output from storage: `if (config.hasCooldown) { ...safeTransfer(receiver, assets); } else { strategy.redeem(assets, receiver, address(this)); }`. The vault's ERC-4626 asset() is the strategy: `__ERC4626_init(IERC20(address(_strategy)))`.
